scenario.topic: Pick the venue for a small spring wedding reception

options.name: Riverside Garden Pavilion
options.upside: Offers a scenic outdoor garden area with a covered pavilion for unpredictable spring weather.
options.concern: Limited parking space may require carpooling or shuttle arrangements.

options.name: Downtown Loft Event Space
options.upside: Close to city center with modern indoor and small rooftop outdoor area.
options.concern: Outdoor space is limited and exposed to weather without full cover.

options.name: Country Club Banquet Hall
options.upside: Spacious indoor hall with a terrace overlooking landscaped grounds.
options.concern: Rental cost may be higher compared to other options.

options.name: Botanical Conservatory Room
options.upside: Unique indoor garden setting with adjacent outdoor paths for guests.
options.concern: Indoor space is smaller and may feel cramped if guest count reaches maximum.

shared_context: A group of four is selecting a venue for a small spring wedding reception with about 30 guests. The venue must have indoor and outdoor space, accommodate light catering, and be within 15 miles of the city center.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager who values spacious, well-equipped venues for events.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the venue is comfortable and impressive for all guests.

A.reason_for: Offers a scenic outdoor garden and covered pavilion, suitable for spring weather.

B.reason_for: Close to city center with modern indoor and rooftop outdoor space.
B.reason_against: Outdoor area is small and exposed to weather.

C.reason_for: Spacious indoor hall with a large terrace and ample capacity.

D.reason_for: Unique indoor garden setting with outdoor paths.
D.reason_against: Smaller indoor space may feel cramped at full guest count.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software developer who prefers practical and convenient event locations.
personas.private_goal: Minimize travel and logistical complications for guests.

A.reason_for: Scenic garden with covered pavilion and within 15 miles of city center.

B.reason_for: Very close to city center with both indoor and rooftop outdoor space.
B.reason_against: Limited outdoor space and lack of full cover outdoors.

C.reason_against: Higher cost and farther distance may complicate logistics.

D.reason_for: Indoor garden and outdoor paths offer a nice atmosphere.
D.reason_against: Smaller indoor space might be tight for 30 guests.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an event planner passionate about unique and memorable settings.
personas.private_goal: Choose a venue that creates a beautiful and comfortable experience for everyone.

A.reason_for: Beautiful outdoor garden with covered pavilion perfect for spring events.

B.reason_for: Modern space close to city center.
B.reason_against: Outdoor area too small and exposed to weather risks.

C.reason_for: Large indoor hall with terrace and landscaped views.
C.reason_against: Cost may be higher than preferred.

D.reason_for: Unique indoor garden atmosphere with outdoor paths.
D.reason_against: Indoor space might feel cramped at max capacity.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a marketing specialist who appreciates spacious and elegant venues.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the venue accommodates all guests comfortably with good amenities.

A.reason_for: Scenic garden and covered pavilion offer flexibility for spring weather.

B.reason_for: Close to city center with modern indoor and rooftop outdoor space.
B.reason_against: Outdoor space is limited and lacks full cover.

D.reason_for: Unique indoor garden setting with outdoor paths.
